We’re introducing legislation w/ @RepBonamici to increase funding for child care providers & improve child care nutrition.
 
The Child Care Nutrition Enhancement Act would address financial challenges faced by providers who use the Child and Adult Care Food Program. https://t.co/e1jDI9WIeL

Our Child Care Nutrition Enhancement Act – endorsed by more than 40+ organizations – would increase funding for family child care homes, child care centers, Head Start programs, and after school programs so they can continue to provide health meals and snacks to our children.

We need commonsense leadership and solutions to address the child care crisis in our country. 
 
Increasing reimbursements for the Child and Adult Care Food Program is essential for our child care providers and our children.
 
More details > https://t.co/Z5M41N2Jx1

22 million Americans depend on the Affordable Care Act subsidies to help pay for their health care.

They will lose subsidies on January 1st.

If we don't act now, millions of those people will lose health care.

If we don’t win this fight to extend tax credits:

➡️ Marketplace premiums will more than double (from $888 to $1,904 on average).
➡️4 million people could lose coverage.
➡️42% of enrollees say they’d go without coverage if their costs double.

We want families to keep their health care. We want the government open.

It’s the easiest deal ever. We’re in this fight to get it done.

More on the numbers from @KFF: 
https://t.co/AuVQVZzw3p

1. This is about healthcare.

➡️24M Americans are going to see their healthcare premiums double.
